title: fagraea auriculata subsp. borneensis
intro: Fagraea auriculata subsp. borneensis, commonly known as Borneo Fagraea, is a plant species belonging to the family Loganiaceae. The plant is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, digestive problems, and skin conditions, due to its numerous health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been the subject of ongoing research.
